question: A developer has been working on a custom application feature within the 'Default' update set. They realize the changes should have been captured in a specific, named update set to facilitate migration to the production instance. What is the most appropriate action to take?

choices.text: Delete the 'Default' update set and recreate the changes in a new update set.
Use the 'Merge' functionality to move the changes from the 'Default' update set into a new, named update set.
Create a new update set, set it to 'In Progress', and manually recreate the configuration changes.
Move the update set to 'Complete' and rename it to the desired functional name.

explanation: The 'Default' update set cannot be moved or merged. Changes captured in 'Default' are not intended for migration. The only way to capture these changes in a transportable update set is to recreate them while the new, named update set is active.
pieges: Believing that the 'Default' update set can be renamed or merged.
Assuming there is an automated tool to 'move' records from one update set to another.
